title: GPT-Live 1 now available on AI Gateway
summary: GPT-Live 1 from OpenAI is now available on AI Gateway. GPT-Live 1 is a full-duplex voice model and can listen and speak at the same time. Many voice models use turn detection to respond. Full duplex removes that boundary, so a user can pause, interrupt, or add detail while GPT-Live is speaking. GPT-Live 1 also supports client delegation.
